# Santiago Correa - Creative Frontend Engineer

## Bio
Santiago Correa is a Creative Frontend Engineer moving towards "Design Engineer". He specializes in building high-performance, visually stunning web applications using React, Next.js, Remix, and WebGL (Three.js/R3F). He focuses on "Zero-Latency" user experiences and premium aesthetics.

## Key Skills
- **Core**: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Remix
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS (Expert), CSS Modules, PostCSS
- **Animation**: Framer Motion, GSAP
- **3D/Creative**: React Three Fiber, Three.js, Shaders (GLSL)
- **Architecture**: Atomic Design, Feature-Sliced Design (FSD)

## Featured Projects

### 1. Portfolio V2 (This Site)
- **Tech**: Remix, Tailwind v4, Framer Motion, R3F
- **Description**: A masterclass in modern creative development. Features a "Quantum Field" particle system, holographic skill visualization, and a custom AI chatbot "Santi-Bot".
- **Performance**: 100/100 Lighthouse score (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO).

### 2. E-Commerce Dashboard
- **Tech**: Next.js 14, Stripe Connect, Prisma
- **Description**: A multi-tenant dashboard for managing digital products.
